reasoning_evidence: Reported queue COD (2028-05-24) tracks the contractual Scheduled COD in Wind IA Amend 4 (2028-04-30) with a ~1-month pad — grounded, not fabricated, but grounded ≠ achievable

COD already drifted 2× in queue reports (2026-09-17 → 2027-12-20 → 2028-05-24) and the IA itself amended the schedule 4 times in 25 months (Orig COD 2027-12-30 → Amend 1 2028-04-30 → held through Amends 2-4) — a pattern of 4-9 month re-anchoring per revision
Grid works are lagging: Ghost Town Substation is a new-build (not in OSM), no CTT groundwork visible in imagery, and the 14-mi 345 kV double-circuit line ROW deed only due 2026-11-01 per Amend 3/4

Datacenter drives the wind: Wind IA Amend 2 (2025-06) adds 840 MW BTM Large Load ISD 2027-10-26; Amend 4 (2026-05) adds Phase 2 420 MW ISD 2028-10-01. Datacenter abatement 'Construction start goal: on or before April 1, 2026 / Completion goal: December 31, 2028' + 'Phase 1 abatement Commencement Date must occur by January 1, 2029' — if datacenter Phase 1 slips past Jan-2029, Meitner Wind loses its integrated BTM load rationale

Financial security escalation is on schedule: $8.1M by 2025-07-21 target → $15.6M by 2025-09-02 → $43.9M by 2026-01-31 → $97.3M by 2026-08-31 (Amend 3 Exhibit E). No default is reflected in the amendments (each clears prior obligations under clause 4).
